items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: we had this guy that owned the Louisine Coffee, Mr. Riley. He came in one night and gave us $20 a piece

ctx.x: That's a cute fish. All right, you know.

And I'll tell you what, we did make a lot of big tips at the Famous Do. Famous Do. Yeah, we had this guy that owned the Louisine Coffee, Mr. Riley. He came in one night and gave us $20 a piece and he's playing, show me the way to go home. $20 a piece. And this guy used to own the South Pole when they had all that big gambling here. The South Pole, used to call him Big Diamond Jim or something. Used to have that big diamond pin up in his chest there. And each side of his pockets, nothing but big packs of money…
